history.summary: A 999-yr leasehold (effectively freehold) 1,410 sqft 3BR off Mar Thoma Rd (D12 Boon Keng-fringe), 2005-built, at $1.89M / $1,340 psf. The low psf is partly a function of an oversized 1,410 sqft layout, the listing has no URA data, and the 1.22km MRT walk plus a vague 'CHEAP' marketing title warrant caution.
history.rating_rationale: 999-yr tenure removes lease-decay risk and the $1,340 psf looks cheap, but the 1,410 sqft is large for a 3BR so the low psf partly reflects size, not a bargain. No URA appreciation or transaction data to validate the price or trend, a 2005 build (21 years), and a 1.22km / 15-min walk to Boon Keng MRT all temper it. $1.89M is a reasonable city-fringe quantum and the tenure is a genuine plus — net Neutral, not a clear buy without verified comps.
red_flags: Oversized 1,410 sqft 3BR — low psf is partly a size artifact
No URA appreciation/transaction data — unverified pricing
1.22km / 15-min to Boon Keng MRT — moderate connectivity
catalysts: 999-yr leasehold — effectively freehold, no decay risk
Large 3BR layout appeals to families wanting space
